question: Can a low-capacity physical-coordinate correction reduce near-flutter optimism and warning misses while explicit accuracy/pessimism constraints avoid the losses caused by resetting the174-feature member?
scope: 77 original TRAIN designs,4454 clips,five existing design folds,seed42,all37 existing acquisition conditions; no TCN,GRU,reserved split,production change or outcome-based tuning.
physical_mechanism: Reuse the dimensionless modal-pair Hurwitz coordinates already numerically verified against Bennett/Chajjed. Correct the frozen spatial blend, never force a sign or replace its members. Same-width generic symmetric modal products are a matched representation control.
references: Exact frozen blend plus the existing seven-column cross-fitted residual-ridge blend_control, replayed against blend_additions_20261002. Reuse15 archived three-way design-cross-fitted107/174 member shards, ignore all physical-prior/oracle readouts. Validate fitting/query rows, source hashes and predictions.
readout: Affine correction on the established seven control columns plus21 measured modal-pair coordinates. Proper TRAIN designs shuffled seed2047+fold and split in half for objective versus constraint validation; all four copies remain together. Input scaling uses objective-design rows only. Correction coefficient unit0.01 margin, L2 coefficient0.1 excluding intercept.
objective: 0.5 mean squared margin error over objective rows +0.5 mean squared positive prediction-minus-truth error on |true margin|<0.05 +0.05 weight-squared sum. This targets optimism without dropping continuous regression. Same objective and partitions for both representations and constrained/unconstrained variants.
constraints: On disjoint proper-TRAIN constraint-design rows: each of four acquisition views' overall squared error and mean squared far-stable underestimation beyond0.05 must not exceed the frozen reference; clean smooth-absolute-error (epsilon1e-6 margin) must not exceed reference. SLSQP analytic gradients, max_iter2000,ftol1e-10; zero correction is feasible. Proxies are not empirical-rate/population guarantees; actual held guardrails remain mandatory.
independence_limit: Objective and constraint designs for the readout are disjoint, and each baseline OOF row is predicted by members not trained on its design. The archived cross-fitted members share fitting designs across readout partitions, so this is not fully independent validation of the entire learning algorithm and does not inherit Cotter's formal guarantees.
primary: Strict optimism>0.03 on -0.01<margin<0; warning misses on this same slice at nominal5% stable calibration false-warning budget. Also stable-last1% optimism and prespecified1% budget. Retain all four budgets and report actual held false warnings.
guardrails: Clean and all-condition design MAE, stable/unstable boundary errors, far-stable underestimation>0.05, actual stable false warnings. Compare physical constrained readout against frozen,seven-column control,matched product constrained and physical unconstrained. No adoption from MAE alone.
calibration: Existing disjoint outer calibration design partition and four unchanged calibration views, residual-Gaussian monotonic unsafe score, existing order-statistic budget thresholds. No calibrating or tuning on held data.
verification: Analytic objective/constraint gradient finite-difference smoke; optimizer success and all constraint slacks checked; exact archived OOF,control and baseline replay; actual waveform inference from raw P4 acquisitions and new saved heads; all calibration budgets,finite outputs and design isolation checked.
uncertainty: 2000 fixed-prediction whole-design bootstrap draws, average paired noise views before resampling; one initialization,repeated TRAIN exploration,no refit uncertainty/multiplicity correction. Preserve every outcome and limitation.
